mentions.name: HOPPVALS-MRF-01
mentions.description: A custom motor controller board that retrofits IKEA window shades with Zigbee-enabled motorization. It connects an ESP32 module to a couple of motor driver ICs via a 12V-to-5V buck circuit and headers, designed in KiCad (using Claude to review the design) with 3D-printed mechanical parts, and fabricated as five boards via JLCPCB.
mentions.problem: IKEA window shades lack Zigbee-enabled motorization, and the motor controller board had to fit a tight space constraint.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been learning electronic PCB design the last few weeks while retrofitting some IKEA window shades for Zigbee enabled motorization.
